candidate.summary:
Duty engine crew onboard the ship underway noticed three
robbers, armed with a knife in the engine room. Alarm
raised, PA announcement made and crew mustered. On
searching the ship, no robbers were found and all ship’s
items accounted for. The incident was reported to VTIS and
the ship was instructed to proceed to the designated
anchorage for further investigations. All crew reported safe.
